about: What no OpenHamShack artefact may link, define or carry (RADIO-SDR-PLAN §5.5, §9.2). AAC (faad2, fdk-aac) and AMBE/IMBE (mbelib) are patent-encumbered and fdk-aac has its own licence; SDRplay's API is proprietary and the user's own. All are only ever opened at run time from the user's install. Patterns are shell globs, matched case-insensitively. Read by tools/check-encumbered.py.
